{{Otheruses|Jammer}}
'''Jammers''' were airborne predators from [[Kidron/Legends|Kidron]] that flew above the jungles using air sacs and wide fins. Their horrible odor could be smelled five meters away, and would overwhelm [[Orfite]]'s sense of smell. Jammers were three meters long and had a three-meter wingspan.
